subject: Post-demo: Proposed pilot plan & success metrics for Grayhawk Systems
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Markov <elena@grayhawk.com>, Tom Breyer <tom.breyer@grayhawk.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Proposed pilot plan & success metrics for Grayhawk Systems

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for a productive demo today. Per our call, I wanted to capture a concise pilot (POC) proposal so we can confirm alignment and get time on calendars. Attached is a short pilot charter and a proposed runbook. High level: 

- Objective: Validate Redwood inference for Grayhawk's document understanding pipeline (OCR -> extraction -> entity classification) at 95% production-parity for the prioritized 10k/month volume.
- Primary success criteria:
  1) End-to-end extraction F1 >= 0.87 on the pilot dataset (we'll share scoring script),
  2) Median API latency <= 220ms 95th percentile under your expected concurrency (2–4 qps),
  3) Total token cost within the modeled budget (we'll share estimates),
  4) No PII exfiltration — data stays in your VPC during the private trial.
- Timeline (proposed):
  Week 0: Kickoff and data handoff checklist (sample set + schema)
  Week 1–2: Environment setup + sample run (SE to provision test cluster)
  Week 3–4: Evaluation runs + metrics collection
  Week 5: Wrap + handoff – decision point and next steps
- Owners: AE (Karthik) — commercial & timeline; SE (Soojin) — provisioning & run support; CSM (Marissa) — success criteria and onboarding.

Action items for Grayhawk to confirm: share a 200–500 document sample with the current labels and nominate a technical contact for provisioning. I've attached the pilot charter, the trial runbook template, and our SOC2 summary for your security team.

Attachments: [Grayhawk_Pilot_Charter_v1.pdf] [trial-runbook.xlsx] [redwood-soc2-summary.pdf]

If the above aligns, can you confirm by EOD Wednesday your preferred kickoff week and the technical contact? Happy to adjust the cadence if you need more runway.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[karthik_iyer@redwood.ai]

From: Elena Markov <elena@grayhawk.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Breyer <tom.breyer@grayhawk.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Proposed pilot plan & success metrics for Grayhawk Systems

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. A few quick clarifications from our side before we lock dates:

- The dataset: we can share a 300-doc sample next day. It includes a mix of invoices and delivery manifests. Will the scoring script handle multiple document schemas?
- Latency target: 220ms median sounds good. Can you also share the expected 95th percentile under a low burst (10 qps for 2 mins) so our infra team can size a VPN tunnel?
- Data handling: our security team will want the SOC2 doc and an architecture diagram showing VPC peering. Is that included in the SOC2 attachment or separate?
- Contracting: procurement is looped (procurement@grayhawk.com). We may need a short MSA + SOW; any standard timelines for legal review?

If we can get answers to the above, we'd prefer to start the pilot week of Jul 23 (gives legal two weeks).

—Elena
Head of Data Products, Grayhawk Systems

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Markov <elena@grayhawk.com>, Tom Breyer <tom.breyer@grayhawk.com>, procurement@grayhawk.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Proposed pilot plan & success metrics for Grayhawk Systems

Elena — thanks, great questions. Short answers below and next steps.

1) Scoring script & multiple schemas: Yes — the scoring harness supports multiple document schemas. We'll ask you to map the label keys in the first dataset handoff; Soojin will validate mapping during week 0.
2) Burst sizing: 95th percentile figures under a short 10 qps burst: median ~240ms, 95th ~360ms for the baseline single-model config; we can lower the 95th by provisioning a small dedicated pool or enabling async batching (trade-off: slightly higher median). I'll include a simple perf table in the shared Drive.
3) SOC2 & architecture: SOC2 summary is attached; architecture diagram is a separate doc I added to the Drive link (see below). Security also often asks for network/configuration checklist — Soojin will share our VPC peering checklist.
4) Contracting: our legal team typically turns around an MSA + simple SOW in ~7–10 business days for pilots. For procurement@grayhawk.com: I'll loop our contracts lead if you want a parallel thread.

Confirmed pilot kickoff: week of Jul 23 works. Proposed immediate next steps:
- Grayhawk: send 300-doc sample + technical contact by Thu 7/12
- Redwood: Soojin to provision test cluster w/ sample token limits by 7/20; Marissa to prepare acceptance dashboard and scoring notebook by 7/22.

Links: Pilot docs + perf table: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4D5E
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/GD-2028-0421

Attachments referenced: [trial-runbook.xlsx] (see Drive for the editable copy)

I'll set an internal task list and calendar invites after I have the technical contact.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Proposed pilot plan & success metrics for Grayhawk Systems (internal)

Karthik / Soojin —

Thanks — quick internal checklist so we don't miss anything before the 7/23 kickoff:
- Marissa: build acceptance dashboard in Looker/Sheets (template located in Drive).
- Soojin: reserve a small dedicated pool for Jul 23–Aug 2 (estimate 1x T4 equivalent); prepare VPC peering checklist and provisioning steps.
- Karthik: open HubSpot task for procurement follow-up and attach MSA template; request procurement contact from Grayhawk.
- Ops: I will ping them to prioritize the trial cluster once Soojin confirms the region (likely us-west-2).

I'll create the HubSpot tasks and share the onboarding checklist with Grayhawk once I have the technical contact.

-Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
